news.summaryTr: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
news.articleText: Here’s what happened in crypto today Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation. Today in crypto: Binance France is closing up shop in the country, as all accounts will be closed on Dec. 31. The US Treasury imposed financial sanctions on eight Canadian money-service companies it claims have done business with sanctioned Iranian entities, and the Treasury also moved to cut MEXC off from the US financial system over alleged illicit transactions. Binance France emails announce closure of accounts Dec. 31 Binance France is closing up shop in the country. Customers have been notified by email during early November, according to media reports. All accounts will be closed on Dec. 31, and any assets left on the exchange will be charged monthly fees starting on Nov. 29, Cryptoast, Crypto Briefing and other media reported on Saturday, citing emails sent to users by Binance. On that date, accounts still maintaining a balance will pay a monthly maintenance fee of 0.025% of the balance, or a minimum of 10 USDC, a stablecoin tracking the US dollar. To avoid fees, withdrawals must be completed by Nov. 29, the exchange said. US sanctions Canadian money-exchange firms over Iran ties The US Treasury imposed financial sanctions on eight Canadian money-service companies it claims have done business with sanctioned Iranian entities. These companies facilitated the exchange of Iranian rials and other currencies for digital assets, enabling international transactions, a US Treasury Department statement said on Friday. The sanctions, which serve to isolate the companies from the dollar-based financial system, are the latest in a series of Treasury moves against firms outside the US. These businesses have facilitated transactions with sanctioned Iranian digital asset exchanges, as well as with digital asset addresses associated with Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), according to the Treasury. US Treasury cuts off MEXC over alleged $16B in illicit transactions The US Department of Treasury on Friday issued an order to cut cryptocurrency exchange MEXC Global off from the US’ financial system after accusing it of facilitating at least $16 billion in transactions linked to sanctions evasion, cybercrime and other illicit activity. The Treasury’s Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) asserted that MEXC handled transactions involving sanctioned groups in Iran, Russia and North Korea between May 2021 and May 2026. This included around $1.5 billion in transactions linked to Russian sanctions evasion, according to the official press release. The order effectively bans US financial institutions from processing money transfers involving MEXC and will take effect 30 days after it is published in the Federal Register. “Financial institutions cannot have it both ways: Either you support the Iranian regime, or you have access to the U.S. financial system,” said Secretary of the Treasury Scott Bessent. “Treasury will continue to sever the Iranian regime’s economic lifelines and thwart its desperate attempts to circumvent U.S. sanctions using digital assets.” The action is part of Operation Economic Outcast, a US Treasury campaign launched in August with aims to cut off financial entities that help Iran evade sanctions. According to DefiLlama, the exchange held about $4.48 billion in total assets as of Friday. Cointelegraph contacted MEXC for comment but had not received a response by publication.

To avoid fees, withdrawals must be completed by Nov. 29, the exchange said. A Binance email cited by Cryptoast said: “Due to the orderly cessation of activities, your Binance France account will close as of December 31, 2026. If you have not withdrawn your crypto-assets as of December 31, 2026, this message constitutes a notification of our intention to consider your account inactive, in accordance with our Terms of Use. This can result in the conversion, transfer or other processing of your crypto-assets.” Key services restricted in June Related: Binance’s EU services face scrutiny over licensing exemption: Report Cointelegraph reported in late June that Binance had notified European Union users access to key services would be restricted after the exchange failed to secure Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) regulatory authorization from a member state before a July 1 deadline. On Sunday, a Binance spokesperson responded to a Cointelegraph query, saying, “Following the end of the MiCA transition period, Binance is progressively restricting certain services for affected users, in line with the schedule previously communicated to them.” Though asked specifically about reports similar emails had also been sent to users in Spain and Belgium, the spokesperson made no mention of them. According to media reports, Binance’s global client base counts at least 300 million customers, while the app was downloaded more than 4 million times in the EU last year. news.articleText: Amsterdam protesters break into Microsoft data center construction site: Report Dutch police said they detained 150-200 people for trespassing during the protest. Protesters reportedly broke into an Amsterdam construction site for a Microsoft data center and clashed with police. Dutch authorities said they detained 150-200 people for trespassing. One protester told a local broadcaster they were trying to stop construction of the data center, according to a report from the Associated Press on Friday. The report added that Microsoft was aware of the demonstration and responded through a spokesperson: “We understand that people feel strongly about the project, and we respect their right to express those views peacefully,” they said. “However, we do not condone any actions that are unlawful or that put people’s safety at risk.” A tougher regulatory environment in the US is expected to follow the recent midterm elections, which saw a wave of Democrats promising to clamp down on data centers, which use large amounts of electricity and water, AP reported. news.titleTr: How the deadly shooting in Krakow unfolded
news.summaryTr: Video authenticated by BBC Verify shows the moment gunshots rang out in Krakow's main market square.
news.articleText: How the deadly shooting in Krakow unfolded Six people were killed and several others injured when a gunman opened fire in central Krakow, Poland's second largest city, on Saturday. Footage authenticated by BBC Verify shows about a dozen people running inside two buildings before a black car with its front window open passes, followed by a police car. Another video shows the moment that gunshots were heard in the city's main market square. Poland's interior minister described the suspect - a 25-year-old Polish citizen - as being inspired by "far-right ideologies"; police said he used "military weapons" in the attack. Hours after the attack, Polish PM Donald Tusk said three other bodies were found at the suspect's home, which is still being searched.

news.summaryTr: Ng will be replaced by Justin Yek, who was formerly vice-president of finance at Airwallex.
news.articleText: Binance’s finance chief Kaiser Ng to leave company, report says Ng will be replaced by Justin Yek, who was formerly vice-president of finance at Airwallex. Binance’s finance chief Kaiser Ng is reportedly leaving that company to pursue a new venture. “Kaiser Ng has decided to pursue a new venture after more than five years at Binance, with a transition plan implemented over the last half year,” Binance co-CEO Yi He said in a statement obtained by Reuters on Saturday. Ng’s LinkedIn profile says he has been Binance’s chief financial officer since January 2022 and before that served in the same capacity at crypto exchange Kraken for about five years. He will be replaced by Justin Yek, who was formerly vice-president of finance at Airwallex, according to the report. The news comes a little more than a week after Binance was hacked for a record $6.3 billion. Cointelegraph reported that hackers stole about $6.3 billion from Binance on Oct. 29, in the largest cryptocurrency theft on record. Binance said it would absorb the losses rather than pass them on to customers. The attack has been attributed to North Korean hackers by the FBI and several researchers, a charge that country has denied. news.title: Traders 'priced out' of £12,000 Christmas market pitches
news.summary: Stall holders said they'd met the council leader to express their concerns at high costs since a new operator took over.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Traders 'priced out' of £12,000 Christmas market pitches
news.summaryTr: Stall holders said they'd met the council leader to express their concerns at high costs since a new operator took over.
news.articleText: Traders 'priced out' of £12,000 Christmas market pitches - Published Traders claim they have been priced out of this year's Christmas market. They have told Liverpool City Council leader Liam Robinson that they cannot afford to take space at the event now that a new operator has taken over running it. Anthony Grice said he had been quoted £12,000 to take a stall at the St George's Plateau attraction. Robinson said he had met business owners to "understand the challenges and the issues that they might have had this year" so the authority could look at different options in future. He said the council had been aware of the price structure being offered to traders by the new operator, Underbelly, when it won the contract to run the event. And he added that the council would get a share of some of the income. But Grice said it felt like local traders' concerns were being "swept under the carpet" during a meeting to discuss the plans. He said: "I asked how many local traders had signed up, and the council didn't know". He added: "These markets should be a chance to showcase the best of what you've got, but not having the 'Scouse soul' there is so annoying. "Aren't our people good enough?" Jeweller Alex Healy, from Gateacre, rang a BBC Radio Merseyside phone-in to tell Robinson that she would not be returning to the market this year, despite having been a trader at previous markets since 2021. She said "It would cost me in the region of £14,000 to £15,000. I have the smallest hut available, but that price I physically cannot afford it." She said she was acutely aware of the cost-of-living crisis facing her customers, adding: "I don't want to raise my prices. I shouldn't have to." Robinson said he wanted entrepreneurs like Healy to succeed and invited her to meet him to look at ways the council could support her business. He added Underbelly had won the tender to run the market "on quality and price" and had a "track record of delivering these markets successfully in lots of other places across the country". Underbelly has been contacted for comment. The leader of the Liberal Democrat opposition group on the council, Carl Cashman, said £14,000 was "a rip-off". He added: "Small businesses are feeling the pinch at the moment, with rising business rates, inflation, and payroll costs, and consumers spending less. "So £14,000 is just a risk too big for them to take, and the market won't be as good for it." A Liverpool city council spokesperson said local traders would be able to sell artisan goods at a street market on Basnett Street running on each Saturday in November, plus at regular and pop-up markets in Lark Lane and Woolton Village in the run-up to Christmas. She said she was acutely aware of the cost-of-living crisis facing her customers, adding: "I don't want to raise my prices. I shouldn't have to." Robinson said he wanted entrepreneurs like Healy to succeed and invited her to meet him to look at ways the council could support her business. He added Underbelly had won the tender to run the market "on quality and price" and had a "track record of delivering these markets successfully in lots of other places across the country". Underbelly has been contacted for comment. The leader of the Liberal Democrat opposition group on the council, Carl Cashman, said £14,000 was "a rip-off". He added: "Small businesses are feeling the pinch at the moment, with rising business rates, inflation, and payroll costs, and consumers spending less. "So £14,000 is just a risk too big for them to take, and the market won't be as good for it." A Liverpool city council spokesperson said local traders would be able to sell artisan goods at a street market on Basnett Street running on each Saturday in November, plus at regular and pop-up markets in Lark Lane and Woolton Village in the run-up to Christmas. news.summary: Saudi Arabia, which leads a coalition fighting the Houthis in Yemen, has not commented.

news.titleTr: Houthis say at least 33 killed in Saudi air strike
news.summaryTr: Saudi Arabia, which leads a coalition fighting the Houthis in Yemen, has not commented.
news.articleText: Houthis say at least 33 killed in Saudi air strike - Published Media linked to the Houthi movement in Yemen say at least 33 people, including women and children, have been killed in air strikes by Saudi Arabia. There has been no comment from the Saudi-led coalition backing the internationally recognised government in Yemen. Live video footage on Al Masirah - a television station run by the Houthis - has shown rescuers pulling bodies out of the rubble of several buildings in al-Shariyah, a town to the east of the capital, Sanaa. The bodies of young children can be seen among those dug out from the ruins. The television station has also shown a number of injured people being carried on stretchers to hospital. Saba news agency, which is also run by the Houthis, said the attack was carried out by Saudi Arabia on Saturday. It added that 39 people had been injured. The Saudis have led a coalition that has been fighting the Houthis for more than a decade in support of Yemen's internationally recognised government. The war in Yemen had been dormant for several years but reignited as a result of the Iran war. A truce began to fall apart when Saudi Arabia struck the airport in Sanaa - which is controlled by the Houthis - to prevent an Iranian plane landing there. The Tehran-backed Houthis subsequently targeted Abha airport in Saudi Arabia, then began hitting Saudi ships that have been using the Red Sea off the coast of Yemen as an alternative oil export route to the Strait of Hormuz. Major fighting has since resumed in Yemen between the Houthis and forces fighting for the Saudi-backed government of Yemen. On Friday, an attack on a market in Taiz province, which has been the focus of much of the recent fighting, is reported to have killed 30 people. The Houthis accused the Saudis of carrying out the strike, while government forces accused the Houthis of having fired a missile at the site. The United Nations says more than 1,600 people have been killed and more than 300,000 displaced since fighting resumed. The Saudis have regularly bombed Houthi positions, while the group has fired multiple missiles at targets inside Saudi Arabia, including airports and oil facilities. Hours before the strike that hit al-Shariyah, the Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted a missile heading towards Riyadh. The Saudi Ministry of Energy later said the Aramco tower had been hit by falling shrapnel in what it said was an attempted attack. The state-owned oil company's building suffered minor damage. A Houthi leader, Mahdi al-Mashat, has vowed that the group will take revenge for the latest attacks in Yemen.

news.title: The Trump coalition is shattered - what will Republicans do now?
news.summary: Republicans can stick with Trumpism or chart a new path, writes BBC Washington correspondent Daniel Bush.

news.titleTr: The Trump coalition is shattered - what will Republicans do now?
news.summaryTr: Republicans can stick with Trumpism or chart a new path, writes BBC Washington correspondent Daniel Bush.
news.articleText: The Trump coalition is shattered - what will Republicans do now? - Published Republicans are in soul-searching mode after the coalition that powered Donald Trump to three straight presidential nominations imploded in spectacular fashion in the 2026 midterms. The stunning election defeat immediately raised questions about the party's future post-Trump. But there are no easy answers as Republicans face the choice of doubling down on Trumpism or trying to chart a new path forward in his final years in office. The depth of the problem was captured by outgoing Florida Governor Ron DeSantis, who called the midterms "close to an extinction-level event for Republicans". Others struck a more optimistic tone. Vice-President JD Vance, who blamed the midterm results on public anger over the war with Iran, argued the party could turn things around. Nevertheless Vance acknowledged the fallout will be messy. "There will be a lot of infighting and arguing over what happened and why," Vance said. The wide range of reactions on the right highlights deep fault lines in the party that formed around Trump's improbable rise to the presidency in 2016 and never really went away. It's too early to tell which faction will win. But while Republicans are still licking their wounds, the intraparty battle Vance predicted is already under way. The party must decide whether it will be "centred on one figure, one guy, or on a wider set of ideas like conservatism that can win outside the deepest red places," Rina Shah, a Republican strategist, told the BBC. Critics on the right - the "Never Trumpers" who opposed his first White House campaign - are pushing for a return to the Republican Party's pre-Trump roots, citing the historic losses around the country on election night. But simply turning back the clock on Trump will be extremely difficult if not impossible to do. The party has been wholly transformed during Trump's decade-long reign. Most Republicans have shifted to the right on domestic issues like immigration, and rejected the interventionist foreign policy of the George W Bush era that led to the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan. In Congress, the more moderate establishment wing of the party that disliked Trump from the start has almost entirely disappeared, replaced by conservative Trump backers who echo his nativism and populist rhetoric. That trend continued this year, as old-guard Republicans like John Cornyn in Texas and Maine's Susan Collins, both of whom clashed with Trump over the years, were voted out of office. Three days after the election Trump appointed Stephen Miller as his new White House chief of staff, replacing Susie Wiles. The move signalled Trump has no plans to moderate his policies or message in his remaining years in office. Miller, who had been serving as the president's chief domestic policy adviser, is a longtime Trump aide known for his hardline immigration policies. - With Stephen Miller pick, Trump readies for a battle - Published1 day ago - How America voted in maps and charts - Published2 days ago One of the architects of the Make America Great Again (Maga) movement, Steve Bannon, predicted a "civil war" in the party after the midterms. Afterwards, he blamed the Republicans' defeat on the economy and "foreign wars". "I don't think we implemented the Maga programme," he said, calling on Trump to double down on mass deportations. But other Republican strategists said the midterms were a wake up call for Make America Great Again (Maga) loyalists who want Trump's political movement to outlast his presidency. "There's still plenty of Maga voters out there who have supported Donald Trump through thick and thin," said Whit Ayres, a Republican strategist. "But there is also a significant portion of the Republican Party that's non-Maga, and that's a majority now." Should Republican hopefuls distance themselves from Trump? The party lost control of the House and Senate, as well as governorships and state legislatures in red states like Texas and Kansas where Democrats had been shut out of power for decades - and where Trump won by double digits when he was on the ballot. The stunning upsets underscored the fickle nature of political coalitions. Trump expanded the Republican base in 2024, increasing support with Latinos and younger voters among other key groups. Republicans hailed the gains as a sign of future strength for the party. Just two years later, the party lost ground with nearly every critical voting bloc. According to a New York Times analysis of voter data, Latino support for Democratic candidates increased by 29 percentage points from 2024-26. Support from young voters 18-29 years old increased by 33 points. The swings reflected polling ahead of the midterms that found widespread disapproval with Trump's handling of the economy, immigration and the war with Iran. Democrats also capitalised on a public perception that the Trump family and administration is rife with self-dealing and corruption. The president's focus on the White House ballroom and other Washington construction projects also contributed to a sense among voters that he was more focused on his legacy than addressing affordability issues. It's a sentiment shared by Benjamin Shrader, the leader of the Young Republicans in Austin, who was still shell-shocked when he spoke to the BBC in Texas the morning after his party was almost wiped out in the state by a Democratic "blue tsunami". Shrader said Trump was still a "force of nature" when asked to reflect on how the president had used his first public appearance after the results to show off the White House ballroom project. He hesitated before adding: "I would focus on issues that are not ballrooms, that are not renaming things. I would focus on what matters." The evidence in the immediate aftermath of the midterms suggests that Republicans could benefit by distancing themselves from Trump ahead of 2028. 'Vance was the favourite - now the race is wide open' Vance tried to thread the needle with his midterm assessment blaming the Iran war and calling for a return to "America First." It was a nuanced critique that broke with Trump on an unpopular war, but embraced a broader political brand that remains popular with the Maga base. Trump's next moves on Iran will be watched closely by the party for their 2028 implications. An escalation would risk fuelling the concerns voiced by Vance and other "America First" proponents. In his postmortem statement on X, Vance also echoed the growing calls on the right to reexamine US support for Israel. But he also signalled an openness to making some immigration enforcement changes. That clashes with Miller, a Vance ally who has speared the administration's second-term immigration agenda. Party strategists said the midterm drubbing complicated Vance's path to the nomination. "Before this midterm, JD Vance was the odds-on favourite to win the Republican nomination in 2028. After this midterm, the nomination battle is completely wide open," Ayres said. Potential Trump successors have some time to consider their options, but they'll have to make up their minds relatively soon. Any 2028 presidential hopefuls will face pressure to announce White House bids in the next few months. Some could launch campaigns before the end of the year. Vance's election analysis was widely interpreted as an unofficial signal of his plans to run. It will likely be a crowded primary field. Other rumoured White House contenders include Secretary of State Marco Rubio, Senator Ted Cruz of Texas, Florida Governor DeSantis, former US ambassador to the United Nations Nikki Haley and former New Jersey Governor Chris Christie, to name a few. In the next election cycle, Republican presidential and congressional candidates alike will have tough decisions to make on key issues of the day, from US support for Israel to tariffs to the AI boom. Trump's power may be diminished as he enters the final two years of his second term, but he'll still have the loudest voice in the party over the next two years. It's unclear whether he will get deeply involved in the process or take a hands-off approach. Trump has praised Vance and Rubio at different times, but typically deflects questions about who he'd like to see succeed him. His endorsement will loom as the biggest wildcard in the 2028 Republican primary race. "It remains to be seen who will jump into that race," Ayres said. "But I think it's going to be a lot larger and more diverse than we anticipated before the midterm election." Follow the twists and turns of Trump's second term with North America correspondent Anthony Zurcher's US Politics Unspun newsletter. Readers in the UK can sign up here. Those outside the UK can sign up here. - Published1 day ago

news.title: Germans wrestle with what to do with Hitler's destroyed Eagle's Nest retreat
news.summary: While some believe the site should be partially or completely rebuilt, others want it abandoned and all memory of its Nazi past forgotten.

news.titleTr: Germans wrestle with what to do with Hitler's destroyed Eagle's Nest retreat
news.summaryTr: While some believe the site should be partially or completely rebuilt, others want it abandoned and all memory of its Nazi past forgotten.
news.articleText: Germans wrestle with what to do with Hitler's destroyed Eagle's Nest retreat - Published Perched on a ridge high up in the spectacular scenery of the German Alps lie the burned-out ruins of a mountain house called The Eagle's Nest, which is now at the heart of an intense debate about Germany's Nazi past. Known in German as Kehlsteinhaus, the retreat was built by the Nazis in 1938, and frequented by Adolf Hitler and other high-ranking Nazis and their guests. After World War Two it was classified as a historical monument recalling the Nazi era. Last month it was gutted by fire in a suspected arson attack, and some believe it should be completely destroyed, the site returned to nature and all memory of its Nazi past forgotten. But others want it either partially or completely rebuilt, wary of the risk of turning it into a site for Neo-Nazi pilgrimage at a time when Germany is witnessing the resurgence of the far-right. Germany has an "everlasting responsibility to communicate, to deal with our Nazi past", said Isabel Heinemann, professor of contemporary history at Munich's Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität (LMU). But rebuilding the site completely, she warned, would mean putting "highly ideologised or highly ideological architecture" back in place. Before it was burned down during the evening of 23 October, the Eagle's Nest had been a popular tourist attraction, owned by the state of Bavaria and operating for many years as a restaurant. Visitors would take a bus and then ride the original brass and mirror-panelled lift through the mountain to the Kehlsteinhaus to savour the magnificent views above the town of Berchtesgaden. Once there, they could eat sausages in the beer garden on the Obersalzberg at 1,834m (6,017ft) above sea level, overlooking the Alps. Unlike Hitler's nearby summer residence, the Berghof, which was bombed in World War Two and demolished in 1952, the Eagle's Nest survived the war. Tens of thousands of tourists visited each season, providing an important source of income to the region. In the 1990s, amid concerns that the site did not do enough to confront the crimes of the Nazi past, a museum, the Obersalzberg Documentation Centre, was opened close by. Around 15 years ago, a photo exhibit was opened in the Kehlsteinhaus about its history. Although the Eagle's Nest itself was "largely destroyed" by the fire, according to police, the documentation centre survived unscathed. The authorities have not commented on a possible motive, but a 33-year-old man with a history of mental illness has been detained in a secure psychiatric hospital on suspicion of arson. - Man arrested after fire at Hitler's mountaintop Eagle's Nest retreat - Published24 October Some feel this is the moment to allow the site to fade into history. "It's been torched now. It's been destroyed. I think they should just clear away the rubble and leave the mountain as it should be in its natural state," said Prof Sir Richard J. Evans, a specialist in Nazi Germany at the University of Cambridge. That has happened with "quite a few other Nazi sites", he argued, including the bunker in Berlin where Hitler killed himself: "The bunker was filled in with concrete and a children's playground put on the top of it on the ground." The Kehlsteinhaus was just "a Nazi vanity project" since romanticised by the name Eagle's Nest, he said. But Bavaria's authorities take a different view about the site's future. Both the state's interior minister, Joachim Herrmann, and its minister for the arts, Markus Blume, have spoken out in favour of rebuilding the Kehlsteinhaus. "We can hardly leave a ruin standing there," Herrmann said. Sven Keller, head of the Obersalzberg Documentation Centre, believes it is important not to leave the site in ruins, as that could encourage Neo-Nazi pilgrims, who would be able to hike up there completely undisturbed. "We have quite some experience at Obersalzberg with what happens if we clear those sites. Hitler's Berghof was demolished in the 1950s, and in our experience, this does not remove such sites from the mental maps of people," he told the BBC's Today programme. Nor does he believe "a one-on-one reconstruction" of the site is possible, and Blume has made clear on Bavarian radio that "it should not and must not cost the taxpayer anything". Herrmann said they would look for a sensible solution in consultation with historians, given the historically complex circumstances surrounding the building. Heinemann, who also heads the Leibniz Institute for Contemporary History, believes full-scale reconstruction should be "out of the question". "I rather think we can document the state left by the fire and also document the historical remains of the Kehlsteinhaus, and then reconstruct parts in a modern design, to make clear the different layers of time that can be seen in this building," she told the BBC. Germany and Austria have long struggled to deal with the fraught legacy of buildings and sites connected to the Nazi era. With the recent rise of the far-right AfD and the Austrian Freedom Party, the debate over Erinnerungskultur (Culture of Remembrance) has taken on a new urgency. A row broke out recently in Germany when AfD and conservative CDU councillors in a town in Saxony decided to ban "stumbling stones" memorials - embedded small brass plaques in the streets - to victims of the Nazis. In Austria over the summer, a police station was opened in the house where Hitler was born in Braunau am Inn. It followed years of controversy about how the house should be used. The Austrian government said the police presence would help prevent neo-Nazi pilgrims. But others had wanted the house to become a centre of responsibility, actively confronting the Nazi past. As one resident of Braunau am Inn told me, it was a delicate balance between how much to remember and how much to forget. Related topics - Published26 September

Sven Keller, head of the Obersalzberg Documentation Centre, believes it is important not to leave the site in ruins, as that could encourage Neo-Nazi pilgrims, who would be able to hike up there completely undisturbed. "We have quite some experience at Obersalzberg with what happens if we clear those sites. Hitler's Berghof was demolished in the 1950s, and in our experience, this does not remove such sites from the mental maps of people," he told the BBC's Today programme. Nor does he believe "a one-on-one reconstruction" of the site is possible, and Blume has made clear on Bavarian radio that "it should not and must not cost the taxpayer anything". Herrmann said they would look for a sensible solution in consultation with historians, given the historically complex circumstances surrounding the building. Heinemann, who also heads the Leibniz Institute for Contemporary History, believes full-scale reconstruction should be "out of the question". "I rather think we can document the state left by the fire and also document the historical remains of the Kehlsteinhaus, and then reconstruct parts in a modern design, to make clear the different layers of time that can be seen in this building," she told the BBC. Germany and Austria have long struggled to deal with the fraught legacy of buildings and sites connected to the Nazi era. With the recent rise of the far-right AfD and the Austrian Freedom Party, the debate over Erinnerungskultur (Culture of Remembrance) has taken on a new urgency. A row broke out recently in Germany when AfD and conservative CDU councillors in a town in Saxony decided to ban "stumbling stones" memorials - embedded small brass plaques in the streets - to victims of the Nazis. In Austria over the summer, a police station was opened in the house where Hitler was born in Braunau am Inn. It followed years of controversy about how the house should be used. The Austrian government said the police presence would help prevent neo-Nazi pilgrims. But others had wanted the house to become a centre of responsibility, actively confronting the Nazi past. As one resident of Braunau am Inn told me, it was a delicate balance between how much to remember and how much to forget. Related topics - Published26 September

news.articleText: Ex-FBI counterintelligence agent stole almost $2.5M in crypto Yaroch paid off his debts and intended to use the proceeds to finance a new life in Portugal, where he planned to buy a vineyard. A former FBI counterintelligence agent admitted to wire fraud and money laundering in stealing almost $2.5 million in cryptocurrency from unidentified adversarial nations and wallets that were under investigation. Patrick Steven Yaroch, 37, used his investigative positions with access to FBI systems to steal cryptocurrency, then exchange and launder it through financial transactions to conceal its source and ownership. Yaroch made about 100 fraudulent transfers related to 35 FBI investigations, gaining $2,474,380.66 in proceeds, according to a news release from the US Attorney’s Office, Eastern District of Virginia on Thursday. He had earlier admitted to unauthorized transfers that involved about $1 million in digital assets, which was reported by Cointelegraph in August. Yaroch paid off his debts and intended to use the proceeds to finance a new life in Portugal, where he planned to buy a vineyard, according to the statement. The former agent admitted that his actions had compromised FBI investigations related to criminal groups and adversarial nations. Yaroch faces up to 20 years in prison. His sentencing is set for March 4, 2027. Magazine: AI agent disputes head to ‘Internet Court’ — and a jury of AI agents

news.titleTr: Bitcoin holders have received eCash — What can you do with it?
news.summaryTr: Bitcoin’s eCash fork gives eligible holders an equivalent balance of ECX, but questions remain over where they can trade the tokens and what they can do with them.
news.articleText: Bitcoin holders have received eCash — What can you do with it? Bitcoin’s eCash fork gives eligible holders an equivalent balance of ECX, but questions remain over where they can trade the tokens and what they can do with them. Somewhere between the Binance hack and the US midterms, Paul Sztorc’s long-awaited Bitcoin fork, known as the eCash network, went live. On Oct. 29, Sztorc, the founder of LayerTwo Labs and the driving force behind the Bitcoin Drivechain proposals BIP300 and BIP301 , launched a separate Bitcoin fork designed to bring payments, privacy and other applications to a network built from Bitcoin’s code. “We need to actively sabotage the ‘degrowth’ policies killing Bitcoin,” Sztorc tells Magazine. “We want to find the true Bitcoin builders and give them the tools to actually innovate. We just need the open-minded, risk-taking contrarians to come and build.” The hard fork gives eligible Bitcoin holders an interesting windfall: their equivalent BTC balance in the new chain’s native token, ECX. So what benefits does eCash bring to developers, and what can Bitcoin HODLers actually do with their new coins? What is eCash? Developed by Sztorc’s LayerTwo Labs, eCash is a separate hard fork of Bitcoin born out of Sztorc’s frustration with some of the “complacency narratives” and “cult-like toxicity” he believes has been holding Bitcoin back. Sztorc dismisses criticism of Drivechains’ security. Source: archive.ecash Its main innovation is Drivechains, a system that gives developers freedom to build independent sidechains with different features without having to make changes to Bitcoin’s base-layer protocol (or in this case, eCash’s base layer). Developers can experiment with different applications for payments, privacy, digital assets and prediction markets, and miners can “maximize their revenues” by earning additional transaction fees. Five sidechains launched alongside eCash’s mainnet: BitNames, BitAssets, Thunder, Truthcoin and zSide, with two more, the quantum-resistant Photon and decentralized exchange CoinShift, still to come. Related: Blockchain developer Paul Sztorc announces BTC hard fork eCash Sztorc has spent over a decade advocating for Drivechains and believes that Bitcoin’s notoriously conservative development approach has held back its potential. “Anything that isn’t maximizing network usage is simply a distraction,” he says. “Users, the ones who actually pay transaction fees to miners, will win in the long run.” Getting access to the new coins The eCash fork took place at Bitcoin block 973,728, and anyone who controlled their private keys at the snapshot received an equivalent ECX balance. “If you held the keys to your BTC at that exact block, you now own the exact same amount of ECX,” LayerTwo Labs tells Magazine. “It is that simple, and you can access them right now.” Like beauty, simplicity is in the eye of the beholder, and Bitcoiners who self-custody their coins will need to use a wallet that supports eCash and carefully follow its process to separate the ECX from their BTC. Because the two networks share transaction history, an unprotected transaction on one chain could be replayed on the other. eCash Market prices. Source: eCash. “Never move your BTC first, as an ordinary, unprotected BTC spend can easily be replayed on the ECX network,” LayerTwo Labs warns. Replay controls are built into the protocol, it says, but the company advises holders to move ECX first, before spending BTC. Anyone keeping BTC on a centralized exchange is “at their mercy regarding distribution,” and should check whether their exchange supports the fork or has announced an ECX distribution. Where can holders trade ECX? Accessing ECX isn’t the same thing as being able to sell it and the tokens are not yet widely available on larger crypto exchanges. Depending on which country you are in, there can be tax implications from Bitcoin forks, which are worth looking up before filing your next tax return. NeoxEX said it opened native ECX deposits, withdrawals and trading on Oct. 29, with ECX/USDT, ECX/USDC and ECX/BTC pairs, while CoinW announced plans to distribute ECX to eligible Bitcoin holders, with deposits, withdrawals and trading to be announced at a later date. Orca, a decentralized exchange on Solana, lets users swap USDC for wrapped ECX (wECX) through a liquidity pool. That gives holders another way to trade exposure to ECX, but it involves a wrapped token on a different blockchain rather than native ECX trading on the eCash network. Related: Binance, Polymarket seek Polygon hard fork to recover $6.8M in stolen crypto How much are the tokens worth? CoinMarketCap placed ECX at $32.63, with around $355,000 in 24-hour trading volume as of Nov. 5, while CoinGecko shows the token as a preview listing, with no price yet available and no tracked exchange markets. Crypto market data provider Kaiko says it does not track ECX, which limits the availability of independent market data. LayerTwo Labs says early trading saw ECX fluctuate between $40 and $50, but it did not provide supporting order book depth or trading volume figures, pointing instead to the Orca pool’s total value locked as a way for users to assess available liquidity. eCash is $32.63 on CoinMarketCap as of Nov. 5 “If our fork replicates even a fraction of [Bitcoin Cash] BCH’s initial performance,” Sztorc says, “the liquidity will be staggering,” adding that anyone concerned about low liquidity can hold their coins and decide later. “We are actively adding new exchanges and trading pairs, so the user experience will only improve,” he says. “Otherwise, you’re welcome to take your free money and leave.” A different vision for Bitcoin Sztorc says the value of eCash will ultimately depend on whether developers build useful applications and users are willing to pay for them. Paying customers and transaction fee revenue are the project’s main measures of success during its first year, he says. He’s not concerned about criticism of Drivechains’ security model, especially the “superstition” that miners could coordinate to steal funds held on sidechains. “If you genuinely believe miners will torch their own billion-dollar operations for a short-term theft on an L2, then you shouldn’t trust Bitcoin’s L1 either,” he says. So for now, eCash gives Bitcoiners a new asset and developers a new playground — but whether ECX becomes much more than that will depend on whether anyone actually wants to use it. news.title: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
news.articleText: Release Number 9323-26 CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today issued an interpretation (“Interpretation”) of the requirement that designated contract markets (“DCMs”) provide competitive, open, fair, and impartial access to their members and persons with trading privileges under Commission Regulation 38.151(b) (“Impartial Access Requirements”). “Derivatives markets must operate on a uniform basis at a national scale in order to achieve the purposes set out in the Commodity Exchange Act,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Geographic access restrictions are inconsistent with those purposes and the Act’s impartial access requirements.” DCMs must cease domestic geographic restrictions that violate the Impartial Access Requirements within 30 days, or else submit to the Division of Market Oversight (“Division”) an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. Further, within 30 days, DCMs should ensure that intermediaries accessing their markets are not impeding and are complying with the DCM’s Impartial Access Requirements, or else submit to the Division an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. The Commission will consider the facts and circumstances of any particular case in connection with potential Commission action. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
news.articleText: Release Number 9321-26 CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets November 04, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the U.S. Department of Agriculture today announced their signing of a Memorandum of Understanding intended to safeguard the integrity of U.S. agricultural markets. The MOU will allow the CFTC and USDA to harmonize policies and practices to better share information and increase access to risk management tools. The agreement will also assist both agencies with monitoring and identifying structural or potential systematic risks, among other things. “For decades, America’s agricultural community has relied on our markets to hedge risk, manage uncertainty, and plan for the future,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “I’m proud that the CFTC and USDA have formalized this partnership through an MOU that will strengthen protections for America’s farmers, ranchers, and producers while expanding opportunities to manage risk through more efficient data sharing. I commend Secretary Rollins for her partnership and commitment to a more coordinated regulatory approach that safeguards the integrity of our markets and ensures they continue serving the agricultural community that feeds and clothes our nation.” “Faster and more transparent data sharing between USDA and CFTC is critical to helping our farmers and ranchers navigate an ever-changing market,” said USDA Secretary Brooke Rollins. “This MOU builds upon USDA’s ongoing data modernization efforts and allows our agencies to collaboratively identify risks and improve responses to market events. Breaking down barriers between government agencies to deliver for our customers is a hallmark of this administration and I am looking forward to the successes this MOU will bring.” -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
news.articleText: Release Number 9320-26 CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Texas entered a default judgment against defendants Walter Dunning Larrick III and Cambridge Financial Advisors LLC for their participation in a commodities fraud scheme. In entering the default judgment, the court found the defendants fraudulently solicited and misappropriated more than $3 million from participants. The court found the defendants falsely represented they would use participant funds to trade futures and options, including those involving natural gas, oil, and gold; made material misrepresentations and omissions about the profitability of commodity trading with them; and issued false account statements to conceal their misconduct. The court further found the defendants misappropriated participant funds by making payments to existing participants in a manner akin to a Ponzi scheme, paying Larrick’s personal expenses, and sending funds to offshore accounts in Costa Rica. The court ordered the defendants to pay a $9,767,625 civil monetary penalty and $3,255,875 in restitution. It also permanently enjoined them from further violations of the Commodity Exchange Act and Commission regulations, as charged, and imposed permanent trading and registration bans. The default judgment resolves all claims in the CFTC’s 2023 complaint. [See CFTC Press Release No. 8768-23.] -CFTC-

The default judgment resolves all claims in the CFTC’s 2023 complaint. [See CFTC Press Release No. 8768-23.] -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
news.articleText: Release Number 9319-26 CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig today released a statement announcing that perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities can begin trading for the first time on designated contract markets that are dually registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission as notice-registered national securities exchanges to trade security futures products. Key excerpts from Chairman Selig’s statement: “Today, perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities (the ‘Equity Perps’) can begin trading for the first time on CFTC-registered exchanges. … “This expansion marks a significant step towards allowing U.S. market participants, consistent with applicable law, to avail themselves of the advantages of perpetual futures that have led to their emergence as widely sought tools for risk-management and price-discovery. I believe that bringing these types of innovative products into our regulated markets ensures that American investors and traders can access these products within the protections of the CFTC’s proven regulatory framework, rather than being forced to turn to offshore, and often unregulated, venues. … “The Equity Perps build on the foundation of the [Commodity Futures Modernization Act of 2000] and the [CFTC-SEC Memorandum of Understanding]. For too long, regulatory uncertainty left innovative products, such as security futures and equity perpetual futures, stranded in what SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins has aptly described as a regulatory ‘no man’s land’ due to a lack of harmonization between the agencies. The CFTC and SEC have turned the page on that era, and are committed to delivering regulatory clarity for innovative products and a clear path to market, rather than more casualties of jurisdictional disputes.” Read Chairman Selig’s full statement here. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
news.articleText: Release Number 9318-26 CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading October 28, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced it will host an industry roundtable Dec. 15 to discuss issues related to the viability of derivatives markets moving to 24/7 trading. The dialogue will build upon the CFTC’s Request for Comment earlier this summer on 24/7 trading. The CFTC’s roundtable will provide a public venue for dialogue on the evolving market structures shaping derivatives markets, including overnight trading, tokenization, infrastructure and staffing needs, and operational readiness. Participants will convene from across the industry to discuss how the Commission can promote responsible innovation while protecting market participants and preserving the integrity and resilience of U.S. derivatives markets. “I have been consistently clear: under my leadership, the CFTC will not take a one‑size‑fits‑all approach to 24/7 trading. Market structure evolves best through thoughtful and responsible progress, and that’s exactly why we’re hosting a roundtable to hear directly from industry on their views for 24/7 trading across different asset classes,” Chairman Selig said. The roundtable will take place at CFTC’s headquarters in Washington. Information regarding the agenda, speakers, and registration will be posted at a later date. This event will be open to the public and livestreamed on CFTC.gov. Please note the number of in-person participants may be limited, and visitors will be subject to security checks. Members of the public are welcome to submit speaker nominations to [email protected]. -CFTC-

news.title: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
news.articleText: Release Number 9317-26 ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026 October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — Last week, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the Risk Management Center at Kansas State University co-hosted the 2026 Agricultural Commodity Futures Conference (AgCon) in Overland Park, Kansas. The two-day conference brought together industry leaders, policymakers, and market participants to examine critical issues facing the agricultural economy, developments in derivatives markets, and the risk management tools American farmers, ranchers, and agribusinesses depend on. Conference Highlights CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig joined K-State President Richard Linton to welcome participants on opening day. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig addressed conference attendees, “I have spent a lot of time this year traveling around the country and talking to farmers and ranchers working hard each day to provide the food, feed, and fiber we depend on throughout our country and the world. I’ve met with farmers, ranchers, agribusinesses, and energy producers in Iowa, Texas, Nebraska, South Carolina, and Florida, and now, I’m with all of you here in Kansas.” [Watch Chairman Selig’s full remarks here.] Following Chairman Selig’s remarks, panelists examined the relationship between cash and derivatives markets, evolving commodity contracts, and the importance of effective hedging tools for agricultural producers. There were also panels where industry representatives addressed access to agricultural credit and the financial challenges facing producers and merchants. Additional afternoon discussions focused on rising production costs, fluctuating commodity prices, supply chain disruptions, and broader pressures on the farm economy. In addition, conference participants engaged in discussions about emerging market developments, including perpetual futures, 24/7 trading, and tokenized collateral, and their implications for agricultural risk management. CFTC Chief Advisor Alex Titus and White House Council of Economic Advisers Member Aaron Hedlund also examined the U.S. economic outlook, agricultural trade, and policies shaping American agriculture. The first day concluded with a keynote address from U.S. Department of Agriculture Deputy Secretary Stephen Vaden. U.S. Senator Roger Marshall of Kansas opened the second day with a morning keynote address on agricultural policy and legislative priorities facing American producers. The morning continued with discussions on agricultural prediction markets, the use of data in modern commodity markets, and developments in event contracts. In addition, panelists examined superintelligence, information advantages, and market integrity, including the implications of emerging technologies for market participants and regulators. Chairman Selig joined Futures Industry Association President and CEO Walt Lukken for a fireside chat examining the Commission’s priorities, the evolving regulatory landscape, and developments shaping derivatives markets. The conference concluded with discussions on enhancing public understanding of markets through data and customer education, followed by a panel examining clearing, market access, and the role of intermediaries in derivatives markets. Chairman Selig delivered closing remarks, concluding AgCon2026. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report
news.articleText: Release Number 9316-26 CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig announced the CFTC’s plan to increase the publication frequency of the Commitments of Traders Report (COT Report) from once to twice a week by the end of 2026. Data from Monday will be published on Wednesday, and data from Wednesday will be published on Friday. Both reports will be released at 3:30 p.m. ET on their respective publication days. Under the enhanced publication schedule, the reports’ latency will decrease from three days to two days. The change follows the Commission’s recent Request for Comment and reflects its commitment to providing market participants with more timely information about trading positions and activity in agricultural markets. The CFTC’s Division of Data is leading the effort to operationalize the expanded publication schedule through modernization and automation while maintaining accuracy. “COT Reports have been an important source of transparency for decades. Following feedback from the agricultural community, I’m pleased to announce the CFTC will be rolling out COT Reports twice a week to ensure this information stream is as useful as possible,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Sues to Block State Enforcement in Utah Amid Ongoing Efforts to Preserve Jurisdiction
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Sues to Block State Enforcement in Utah Amid Ongoing Efforts to Preserve Jurisdiction
news.articleText: Release Number 9315-26 CFTC Sues to Block State Enforcement in Utah Amid Ongoing Efforts to Preserve Jurisdiction October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission announced today it has filed a lawsuit against Utah to block the state’s efforts to shut down CFTC-registered contract markets using state laws. The lawsuit follows Utah’s decision to file civil enforcement actions in state court against CFTC-regulated markets and other businesses. Utah’s effort to restrict the functioning of CFTC-registered exchanges obstructs Congress’s decision to federally preempt state law. “Utah seeks to shut down prediction markets across a wide variety of markets,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Event contracts do not just serve hedging and investment purposes—they also provide the public with information about the outcome of future events. Congress entrusted the CFTC to be the federal regulator with sole responsibility to oversee these markets. As I’ve said before, the CFTC has the expertise and responsibility to defend its exclusive jurisdiction over commodity derivatives, and that’s exactly what we’ll do.” This action reflects the CFTC’s firm commitment to maintaining its exclusive jurisdiction over CFTC-registered prediction markets. The CFTC continues to draw a clear line: if a state challenges the lawful operation of a derivatives exchange, the Commission will protect federal sovereign interests. The Commission has also initiated legal proceedings against nine other states and has submitted briefs in four federal courts of appeal and one state supreme court. -CFTC-

items.title: Nvidia CEO'su Jensen Huang hakkında soruşturma kararı: İstihbarat iddiası gündemde
items.summary: ABD'li çip devi Nvidia, CEO Jensen Huang'ın yabancı istihbarat faaliyetinin hedefi olduğuna ilişkin haberlerin ardından bağımsız soruşturma başlatıyor. Şirketin yönetim kurulu, incelemenin bağımsız hukuk danışmanlarının desteğiyle yürütüleceğini açıkladı.

items.summaryTr: ABD'li çip devi Nvidia, CEO Jensen Huang'ın yabancı istihbarat faaliyetinin hedefi olduğuna ilişkin haberlerin ardından bağımsız soruşturma başlatıyor. Şirketin yönetim kurulu, incelemenin bağımsız hukuk danışmanlarının desteğiyle yürütüleceğini açıkladı.
items.articleText: Nvidia CEO'su Jensen Huang hakkında soruşturma kararı: İstihbarat iddiası gündemde - ABD'li çip devi Nvidia, CEO Jensen Huang'ın yabancı istihbarat faaliyetinin hedefi olduğuna ilişkin haberlerin ardından bağımsız soruşturma başlatıyor. - Şirketin yönetim kurulu, incelemenin bağımsız hukuk danışmanlarının desteğiyle yürütüleceğini açıkladı. ABD'li çip üreticisi Nvidia, CEO Jensen Huang hakkında gündeme gelen istihbarat iddiaları üzerine harekete geçti. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Şirketin yönetim kurulu, Huang'ın yabancı istihbarat faaliyetinin hedefi olduğuna ilişkin haberlerin ardından bağımsız soruşturma başlatılmasına karar verdi. Nvidia Yönetim Kurulu'ndan yapılan açıklamada, soruşturmanın bağımsız yönetim kurulu üyelerinden oluşan bir komite tarafından yürütüleceği ve sürece bağımsız hukuk danışmanlarının da destek vereceği bildirildi. Yönetim kurulu, ABD'nin ulusal ve ekonomik güvenliğinin yanı sıra şirketin ve hissedarlarının çıkarlarının korunmasına öncelik verildiğini vurguladı. Nvidia: "Gizli bilgilerin tehlikeye atıldığına dair gerekçe yok" Açıklamada, yönetim kurulunun şu aşamada ne ulusal güvenliğin ne de Nvidia'ya ait gizli bilgilerin tehlikeye atıldığına inanmak için bir gerekçesi bulunmadığı belirtildi. Buna rağmen soruşturma kapsamında mevcut tüm bilgilerin değerlendirileceği kaydedildi. Jensen Huang'ın incelemeye tam destek verdiği ve soruşturmayla işbirliği yapmayı taahhüt ettiği aktarıldı. Yönetim kurulu ayrıca Huang'a ve şirketin liderlik ekibine güven duyduğunu bildirdi. Çin bağlantılı istihbarat iddiası gündeme gelmişti The New York Times gazetesinde geçen hafta yayımlanan haberde, Jensen Huang'a yakın olduğu belirtilen Çinli iş insanı Alice Huang'ın Pekin yönetimine istihbarat amacıyla bilgi sızdırdığı öne sürülmüştü. Nvidia'nın başlattığı soruşturma, söz konusu haberlerin ardından şirket yönetiminin iddiaları bağımsız şekilde inceleme kararı alması açısından önem taşıyor. Nvidia neden kritik önemde? Nvidia, yapay zeka sistemlerinin eğitilmesi ve çalıştırılmasında kullanılan grafik işlemcileriyle küresel teknoloji sektörünün en önemli şirketleri arasında yer alıyor. ABD ile Çin arasındaki çip rekabetinde de şirketin ürünleri ve teknoloji ihracatı stratejik önem taşıyor. Bu nedenle Nvidia yönetimine ilişkin güvenlik iddiaları, şirketin ticari faaliyetlerinin yanı sıra teknoloji ve ulusal güvenlik politikaları açısından da yakından takip ediliyor.

items.summaryTr: Apple, iPhone kullanıcıları için iOS 27.3'ün ilk geliştirici beta sürümünü yayımladı. Yeni güncelleme Siri'nin yapay zeka yeteneklerini genişletirken Sağlık uygulamasını yeniden tasarlıyor, Safari'ye yeni gizlilik ve gezinme seçenekleri ekliyor.
items.articleText: Apple iOS 27.3 ile iPhone'lara yeni özellikler geliyor: Siri, Sağlık ve Safari yenileniyor Apple, iPhone kullanıcıları için iOS 27.3'ün ilk geliştirici beta sürümünü yayımladı. Yeni güncelleme Siri'nin yapay zeka yeteneklerini genişletirken Sağlık uygulamasını yeniden tasarlıyor, Safari'ye yeni gizlilik ve gezinme seçenekleri ekliyor. Apple, iPhone'lar için yeni işletim sistemi güncellemesi iOS 27.3 üzerinde çalışmalarını sürdürüyor. Şirket, 3 Kasım'da ilk geliştirici beta sürümünü kullanıma açtı. Yeni sürüm, ekim ayında yayımlanan iOS 27.2'nin ardından önemli yenilikler getiriyor. iOS 27.3 ile özellikle Siri'nin yapay zeka özellikleri genişletiliyor. Bunun yanı sıra Sağlık uygulaması yeniden tasarlanıyor, Safari'nin kullanım seçenekleri artırılıyor ve iPhone Duo kullanıcılarına yönelik yeni özellikler sunuluyor. Siri artık iPhone uygulamalarında daha fazla işlem yapabilecek iOS 27.3'ün öne çıkan yeniliklerinden biri Siri'nin yapay zeka destekli yeteneklerindeki genişleme oldu. Apple'ın açıklamasına göre Siri; Mail, Safari, Dosyalar, Takvim, Mesajlar, Fotoğraflar, Notlar ve Anımsatıcılar gibi uygulamalarda daha ayrıntılı işlemler gerçekleştirebilecek. Yeni özellik sayesinde kullanıcılar, daha önce ziyaret ettikleri bir konumu bulmak veya bir yıldan uzun süredir açılmayan dosyaları arşivlemek gibi çok adımlı görevleri Siri'ye verebilecek. Apple ayrıca üçüncü taraf uygulamaların da Siri yapay zeka entegrasyonunu test edebilmesi için geliştirici önizlemesini başlattı. App Intents altyapısı üzerinden geliştirilecek özelliklerin App Store'a sunulmasına ise ilkbaharda izin verilmesi planlanıyor. Siri'nin yapay zeka özellikleri şu anda İngilizce, Fransızca, Japonca, Korece, Portekizce ve İspanyolca dillerini destekliyor. Gelen yeni dil seçenekleri arasında Türkçe, Geleneksel Çince, Norveççe ve Vietnamca da bulunuyor. Ancak Avrupa Birliği'nde iPhone kullanıcıları için Siri yapay zeka özelliklerine erişim henüz sunulmuyor. Apple Sağlık uygulamasını yeniden tasarlıyor iOS 27.3 beta sürümünde yeniden test edilmeye başlanan Sağlık uygulaması da önemli değişiklikler içeriyor. Yeni tasarımda Öngörüler sekmesi, kullanıcının sağlık verilerini ve kişiselleştirilmiş önerilerini tek bir yerde topluyor. Uzun vadeli sağlık eğilimlerini takip etmeye yönelik Uzun Ömürlülük bölümü de uygulamaya ekleniyor. Sağlık Yaşı özelliği ise Apple Watch üzerinden elde edilen dinlenme kalp atış hızı, uyku, kalp atış hızı değişkenliği ve VO2 max verilerini kullanarak kullanıcının sağlık göstergelerini kronolojik yaşıyla karşılaştırıyor. Apple, yenilenen Sağlık uygulamasına Türkçe dahil daha fazla dil desteği de ekliyor. Safari'ye yeni gizlilik ve gezinme seçenekleri Yeni güncelleme Safari tarayıcısında da değişiklikler getiriyor. İlk beta testlerinde dikey sekme seçeneğinin ayarlara eklendiği görüldü. Ayrıca kendi karanlık görünümünü sunmayan internet siteleri için Uyarlanabilir Karanlık Mod özelliği üzerinde çalışılıyor. Safari'nin gelişmiş ayarlarına eklenen Küresel Gizlilik Kontrolü seçeneği de kullanıcıların gizlilik tercihlerini yönetmesini kolaylaştırmayı amaçlıyor. iPhone Duo'ya tek elle kullanım kolaylığı iPhone Duo kullanıcıları da iOS 27.3 ile yeni özelliklere kavuşacak. Cihazın dış ekranında tek elle kullanımı kolaylaştıran Erişilebilirlik özelliği, ekran içeriğini başparmağa daha yakın bir konuma taşıyabilecek. Bunun yanında dış ekran klavyesinde emoji, sayı, mikrofon ve geri dönüş tuşlarının konumları ile tuş boyutları yeniden düzenleniyor. Bekleme Modu'nda da yeni saat tasarımları, Takvim ve Hava Durumu düzenleri ve daha fazla kişiselleştirme seçeneği sunuluyor. Kullanıcılar birden fazla saat görünümü oluşturup bunlar arasında geçiş yapabilecek. Apple Intelligence Çin'de kullanıma sunuluyor iOS 27.3 ile Apple Intelligence özellikleri de Çin ana karasındaki desteklenen iPhone modellerine gelmeye başlıyor. Yazma Araçları, Genmoji, Görsel Zeka, Temizleme ve özetleme özelliklerini kapsayan dağıtımda, belirli deneyimler için Alibaba'nın Qwen yapay zeka modeli kullanılacak. Ancak yeni Siri yapay zeka sistemi ilk aşamada bu kapsama dahil edilmeyecek. iOS 27.3 ne zaman yayınlanacak? Apple, iOS 27.3'ün ilk geliştirici beta sürümünü 3 Kasım'da yayımladı. Güncellemenin aralık ayında genel kullanıma açılması bekleniyor. Bazı özelliklerin cihaz modeline, dile ve bölgeye göre farklılık gösterebileceği belirtiliyor.

items.title: Fox'tan 22 milyar dolarlık dev hamle: Yayın devi artık bünyesinde
items.summary: ABD'li medya şirketi Fox, 22 milyar dolarlık Roku satın almasını tamamladı. Anlaşmayla 100 milyondan fazla haneye ulaşan yayın platformu Fox bünyesine katılırken şirket, ABD'nin izleyici sayısına göre üçüncü büyük televizyon işletmesi konumuna yükseldi.

items.titleTr: Fox'tan 22 milyar dolarlık dev hamle: Yayın devi artık bünyesinde
items.summaryTr: ABD'li medya şirketi Fox, 22 milyar dolarlık Roku satın almasını tamamladı. Anlaşmayla 100 milyondan fazla haneye ulaşan yayın platformu Fox bünyesine katılırken şirket, ABD'nin izleyici sayısına göre üçüncü büyük televizyon işletmesi konumuna yükseldi.
items.articleText: Fox'tan 22 milyar dolarlık dev hamle: Yayın devi artık bünyesinde - ABD'li medya şirketi Fox, 22 milyar dolarlık Roku satın almasını tamamladı. - Anlaşmayla 100 milyondan fazla haneye ulaşan yayın platformu Fox bünyesine katılırken şirket, ABD'nin izleyici sayısına göre üçüncü büyük televizyon işletmesi konumuna yükseldi. ABD medya sektörünün en büyük satın almalarından biri tamamlandı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Fox, çevrim içi yayın ve bağlantılı televizyon alanında faaliyet gösteren Roku'yu 22 milyar dolar karşılığında satın alma işlemini sonuçlandırdı. TechCrunch'ın haberine göre 2002 yılında kurulan Roku resmen Fox bünyesine katıldı. Fox, satın alma sonrasında birleşik şirketin ABD'de izleyici sayısı bakımından üçüncü büyük televizyon işletmesi haline geldiğini açıkladı. Roku'nun kurucusu Anthony Wood, satın almanın ardından yaptığı açıklamada şirketin televizyon izleme deneyimini geliştirme hedefinin değişmediğini belirtti. Wood, Fox'un desteğiyle şirketin erişim alanının ve kaynaklarının genişleyeceğini, ekiplerin ürün geliştirme ve yenilik çalışmalarını sürdüreceğini ifade etti. Fox'un hedefinde 100 milyondan fazla hane var Satın alma, Fox'a Roku'nun 100 milyondan fazla haneye ulaşan kullanıcı ağına doğrudan erişim imkanı sağlıyor. Şirket, bu geniş erişim sayesinde reklam hedeflemesini geliştirmeyi, hızla büyüyen bağlantılı televizyon pazarındaki konumunu güçlendirmeyi ve geleneksel televizyon dağıtım kanallarına bağımlılığını azaltmayı hedefliyor. Anlaşma, ABD'de televizyon izleme alışkanlıklarının dijital platformlara ve bağlantılı televizyon sistemlerine kaydığı bir dönemde Fox'un dijital yayıncılık alanındaki gücünü artıracak. 22 milyar dolarlık anlaşma beklenenden erken tamamlandı Satın alma süreci ABD Adalet Bakanlığı'nın rekabet incelemesine de takılmıştı. Bakanlık, eylül ayında anlaşmaya ilişkin ek bilgi ve belge talep ederek iki şirket hakkında ikinci bir inceleme başlatmıştı. Kasım ayının başında yayımlanan haberlerde ise satın almanın ABD'deki düzenleyici denetimden geçmeye yaklaştığı belirtilmişti. Haziran ayında duyurulan anlaşmanın 2027'nin ilk yarısında tamamlanması bekleniyordu. Ancak süreç öngörülenden daha kısa sürede sonuçlandı ve satın alma planlanandan önce tamamlandı İnternet bağlantılı televizyon pazarı neden büyüyor? Bağlantılı televizyon (Connected TV), internete bağlanabilen akıllı televizyonlar ve yayın cihazları üzerinden dijital içerik izlenmesini ifade ediyor. Bu pazar, geleneksel televizyon yayıncılığından farklı olarak reklamverenlere izleyici davranışlarına göre daha hedefli reklam sunma imkanı sağlıyor. Bu nedenle medya şirketleri, dijital yayın platformlarına ve kullanıcı verilerine erişim sağlayan yatırımlara ağırlık veriyor.

items.title: Seven dead and more than 100 injured after trains collide in Egypt
items.summary: Several carriages derailed after two trains travelling in the same direction crashed outside the city of Giza.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Seven dead and more than 100 injured after trains collide in Egypt
items.summaryTr: Several carriages derailed after two trains travelling in the same direction crashed outside the city of Giza.
items.articleText: Seven dead and more than 100 injured after trains collide in Egypt - Published At least seven people have died in a train crash near the Egyptian city of Giza, with more than 100 injured. The country's railway authority said two trains travelling south from Giza and Cairo collided, causing several carriages to derail and fall down an embankment. Images from the scene showed people looking inside overturned carriages for injured passengers as a massive emergency response was launched. Egyptian President Abdul Fattah al-Sisi said he had ordered state authorities to "investigate the circumstances of the accident, and hold accountable anyone found to have been negligent". The public prosecutor's office warned the death toll could rise. The government said hospitals in the area had been put "on heightened alert" as they dealt with a massive influx of patients. Egypt's health minister Dr Khaled Abdel Ghaffar said people were being treated for broken bones and head injuries. The Egyptian Red Crescent said it was providing aid and psychological support to victims and their families at the scene. The driver of one of the trains was among those who died in the crash, the ministry confirmed. The first train involved in the crash was travelling from Giza to Fayoum, south of Cairo, when it crashed into the rear of another service heading south from Cairo to Aswan, which was stationary on the tracks. Images from the scene showed some carriages had overturned, with the body of at least one appearing to have split in two. Trains between Giza and the Upper Egypt region were suspended as cranes were dispatched to remove the wrecked trains. The railway authority has not said how long it expects this to take. The collision occurred in the area between Kafr Ammar and Al-Raqqa stations in Al-Ayyat, close to where Egypt's deadliest train tragedy occurred in February 2002, when a fire engulfed a passenger train travelling from Cairo to Luxor. Saudi Arabia's ministry of foreign affairs expressed "solidarity" with Egypt and wished those hurt a speedy recovery. Turkey's ambassador to Egypt wrote on X that he extended "heartfelt condolences and sincere sympathy" to the victims, their families, and the Egyptian people.

items.articleText: Çinli otomobiller Avrupa'da güvenlik kıskacında: BYD için kritik başvuru - Avrupa Parlamentosu üyeleri, güvenlik risklerini gerekçe göstererek Çinli otomobil üreticisi BYD'nin kamu alımlarından çıkarılmasını ve araçlarının askeri tesisler ile stratejik bölgelere girişinin kısıtlanmasını istedi. - Milletvekilleri, bağlantılı araçlardaki kamera, GPS ve sensörlerin casusluk amacıyla kullanılabileceği uyarısında bulundu. Avrupa'da Çinli otomobil üreticilerine yönelik güvenlik endişeleri gündeme taşındı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Avrupa Parlamentosunun (AP) bazı üyeleri, Çin merkezli BYD'nin kamu alımlarından dışlanması ve araçlarının askeri tesisler ile hassas altyapılara erişiminin sınırlandırılması için Avrupa Birliği (AB) Komisyonuna başvurdu. AP üyesi Francois Kalfon, kişisel internet sitesinden yaptığı açıklamada, 8 milletvekiliyle birlikte Çinli şirketlerin ürettiği bağlantılı araçların oluşturabileceği casusluk risklerine ilişkin AB Komisyonuna başvurduklarını bildirdi. Kalfon ayrıca Fransa Başbakanı Sebastien Lecornu'ya da konuyla ilgili mektup gönderdi. Kameralar ve GPS sistemleri güvenlik riski olarak gösterildi Başvuruda, bağlantılı araçlarda bulunan kameralar, GPS sistemleri, mikrofonlar ve lazer sensörlerinin hassas verilerin toplanmasında kullanılabileceği savunuldu. Bu teknolojilerin özellikle askeri üsler ve stratejik altyapıların yakınında güvenlik riski oluşturabileceği öne sürüldü. Açıklamada, İngiltere ve Polonya'nın Çinli şirketler tarafından üretilen araçların askeri tesislere erişimini kısıtladığı, ABD ordusunun da Japonya'daki üssünde BYD araçlarının kullanımını yasakladığı belirtildi. Fransa'nın ise henüz benzer önlemleri hayata geçirmediğine dikkat çekildi. BYD için Avrupa'da yeni kısıtlama talebi Milletvekilleri, Fransa ve AB'nin önlem almak için kanıtlanmış bir casusluk vakasının ortaya çıkmasını beklememesi gerektiğini savundu. Hibrit savaş ortamında stratejik tesislerin korunması için hızlı hareket edilmesi çağrısı yapıldı. Fransız hükümeti ve AB Komisyonu'ndan BYD araçlarının askeri tesisler ile hassas altyapılara erişiminin sınırlandırılması ve şirketin kamu alımlarından çıkarılması istendi. Ayrıca müzakereleri devam eden AB siber güvenlik düzenlemesi kapsamında BYD'nin yüksek riskli tedarikçi olarak sınıflandırılması ve şirketin araçlarının Avrupa'ya ithalatının sınırlandırılması çağrısında bulunuldu. Bağlantılı otomobiller neden güvenlik tartışmalarının odağında? Bağlantılı otomobiller, kamera, konum belirleme, mikrofon ve çevresel algılama sistemleri sayesinde sürekli veri üretebiliyor. Bu veriler sürüş güvenliği ve araç içi hizmetler için kullanılırken, hassas bölgelerde veri güvenliği ve bu bilgilere kimlerin erişebildiği konusunda soru işaretleri yaratabiliyor. Avrupa'da Çinli teknoloji ve otomobil şirketlerine yönelik güvenlik incelemeleri de bu tartışmaların bir parçası haline geliyor.

items.summary: İtalya'nın Sardinya Adası'ndaki Ollolai kasabası, Work From Ollolai programıyla katılımcılara bir aylık konaklamayı sembolik 1 euro kira bedeliyle sunuyor. Programa kabul edilenlerden ise mesleki bilgi ve deneyimlerini kasaba halkıyla paylaşmaları bekleniyor.

items.titleTr: İtalya'da 1 euroya tatil fırsatı: Bir ay boyunca evde konaklama imkânı
items.summaryTr: İtalya'nın Sardinya Adası'ndaki Ollolai kasabası, Work From Ollolai programıyla katılımcılara bir aylık konaklamayı sembolik 1 euro kira bedeliyle sunuyor. Programa kabul edilenlerden ise mesleki bilgi ve deneyimlerini kasaba halkıyla paylaşmaları bekleniyor.
items.articleText: İtalya'da 1 euroya tatil fırsatı: Bir ay boyunca evde konaklama imkânı - İtalya'nın Sardinya Adası'ndaki Ollolai kasabası, Work From Ollolai programıyla katılımcılara bir aylık konaklamayı sembolik 1 euro kira bedeliyle sunuyor. - Programa kabul edilenlerden ise mesleki bilgi ve deneyimlerini kasaba halkıyla paylaşmaları bekleniyor.İtalya'nın Sardinya Adası'ndaki Ollolai kasabası, Work From Ollolai programıyla katılımcılara bir aylık konaklamayı sembolik 1 euro kira bedeliyle sunuyor. - Programa kabul edilenlerden ise mesleki bilgi ve deneyimlerini kasaba halkıyla paylaşmaları bekleniyor. İtalya'da düşük maliyetle konaklamak isteyenler için dikkat çeken bir program başlatıldı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Sardinya Adası'nda bulunan Ollolai Belediyesi'nin yürüttüğü Work From Ollolai programı kapsamında, farklı mesleklerden kişiler bir ay boyunca sembolik kira bedeliyle kasabada yaşayabiliyor. Programla, farklı ülkelerden gelen profesyonellerin bilgi ve deneyimlerini yerel halkla paylaşması, kasaba sakinlerinin yeni meslekler ve çalışma yöntemleriyle tanışması amaçlanıyor. Konaklama karşılığında bilgi ve deneyim paylaşımı Programa kabul edilen katılımcılardan uzmanlık alanlarına göre halka açık sunumlar yapmaları, ders vermeleri veya yerel projelere katkı sunmaları isteniyor. Bu kapsamda teknoloji, medya, finans, emlak ve mimarlık alanlarında çalışan profesyoneller ile girişimciler öncelikli başvuru grupları arasında yer alıyor. Sanatçılar, yazarlar, müzisyenler, bilim insanları ve akademisyenler de programa başvurabiliyor. Bir veya iki yatak odalı evlerde kalabilecekler Program kapsamında katılımcılara müsaitlik durumuna göre bir veya iki yatak odalı evler tahsis ediliyor. Ev sahibiyle sembolik 1 euro kira bedeli üzerinden sözleşme imzalanıyor. Konaklama süresi en fazla bir ay olarak belirlenirken, daha uzun süre kalmak isteyenlerin talepleri ayrıca değerlendiriliyor. Yemek ve ulaşım masrafları katılımcılara ait Bir euroluk ödeme yalnızca kira bedelini kapsıyor. Yemek, faturalar, depozito ve ulaşım giderleri katılımcılar tarafından karşılanıyor. Belediye, vize ve vergi işlemlerinde de destek sağlamıyor. Bu nedenle programa katılmak isteyenlerin seyahat öncesinde vize ve diğer yasal gereklilikleri araştırması gerekiyor. 1 euroluk ev satışlarıyla da gündeme gelmişti Sardinya Adası'nda, uzun yaşam süreleriyle öne çıkan Mavi Bölge'nin bulunduğu coğrafyada yer alan Ollolai, daha önce 1 euroluk ev satışlarıyla gündeme gelmişti. Kasabada kalıcı olarak yaşamak isteyenlere yönelik bu uygulama, Work From Ollolai kapsamında sunulan bir aylık konaklama programından ayrı yürütülüyor. Sardinya'nın Mavi Bölge özelliği Sardinya Adası'nın bazı bölgeleri, dünyada insanların 100 yaşını aşma oranlarının yüksek olduğu yerleri tanımlamak için kullanılan "Mavi Bölge" kavramıyla anılıyor. Beslenme alışkanlıkları, günlük fiziksel hareketlilik, sosyal ilişkiler ve yaşam biçimi bu bölgelerde uzun yaşamla ilişkilendirilen başlıca unsurlar arasında gösteriliyor.
